_description: Cascade Predictive 11 — Second cohort for Predictive tier validation. Fresh accounts in HR tech, climate tech, and media verticals. Same KPI set as predictive_11_saas.json, entirely new narratives.
_capabilities_unlocked: Single Point of Failure simulation (Persona Breadth → champion departure risk)
Friction vs Value calibration (Golden Path + NPS gap analysis → frustrated power user detection)
138-day early warning (Golden Path + Exec Engagement → competitor POC arc at 90% confidence)

_kpi_map.P1-KPI1: DAU Rate — baseline frequency for Signal Analyst
_kpi_map.P1-KPI10: Golden Path Velocity — Behavioral LEAD: detects stalling before DAU drops
_kpi_map.P2-KPI1: Exec Sponsor Engagement — STAKEHOLDER node: high-risk if dark
_kpi_map.P2-KPI8: Persona Breadth — Structural LEAD: protects against single-point-of-failure
_kpi_map.P3-KPI1: Ticket Resolution Time — Power-of-1: Cost Savings
_kpi_map.P3-KPI3: NPS — Sentiment Anchor: calibrates all other signals
_kpi_map.P3-KPI4: Escalation Rate — SIGNAL node: triggers crisis_recovery arc
_kpi_map.P5-KPI1: NRR — L4 Health: valuation impact (EV/Revenue multiples)
_kpi_map.P5-KPI3: Expansion Revenue Rate — Power-of-1: Revenue Growth

single_point_of_failure.question: What happens if our Champion at Pinnacle HR leaves?
single_point_of_failure.logic: Persona Breadth < 2.0 + Champion departure → 90% probability of silent_churn arc in 30 days

friction_vs_value.question: Are Meridian Media users getting value or just stuck?
friction_vs_value.logic: High Golden Path Velocity + Low NPS = Frustrated Power User → prime competitor target

early_warning_138d.question: Is a competitor POC starting at OceanBlue Climate?
early_warning_138d.logic: Declining Golden Path + Exec Disengagement → competitor_poc arc at ~90% confidence, 138 days before churn

accounts.name: Pinnacle HR Platform
accounts.narrative: HR tech Series B. Golden Path Velocity at 81% — talent acquisition and onboarding workflows running faster than benchmark. Persona Breadth 4.5 (HRBP, Recruiter, Analyst, Manager). NPS 58. Multi-department expansion secured Q1.

key_signals.content: Golden Path Velocity at 81% — 4 HR personas fully active, recruiting cycle time down 31%
CHRO requesting expansion to compensation and L&D teams — 55 new seats

accounts.name: Atlas Retail Intelligence
accounts.narrative: Retail analytics SaaS. Golden Path at 70%, Persona Breadth 3.8. NRR 114%. Exec sponsor (CPO) engaged bi-weekly. Strong pipeline — seasonal analytics expansion for holiday 2026 planning underway.

key_signals.content: CPO joined strategic roadmap review — committed to 3-year deal discussion for H2

accounts.name: Meridian Media Group
accounts.narrative: Digital media SaaS. Golden Path Velocity 52% (below target). Persona Breadth 2.6 (borderline). NPS 35 — the 'Friction vs Value' pattern: editors complete workflow but hate the UI. Prime target for competitive displacement.

key_signals.content: NPS dropped from 42 to 35 — editorial team frustrated with publishing workflow UX
Platform engineer submitted 15 UX bugs in 30 days — frustrated power user pattern confirmed

accounts.name: OceanBlue Climate Tech
accounts.narrative: Climate analytics SaaS. Head of Sustainability Data (champion) moved to competitor in Jan. Persona Breadth collapsed from 4.0 to 1.4. Golden Path tanking — only junior analyst active. Exec sponsor went silent 6 weeks ago.

key_signals.content: Dr. Sorenson left for competitor — was sole power user and internal champion
Persona Breadth collapsed from 4.0 to 1.4 — only junior analyst active
CSO has not responded to 4 outreach attempts over 6 weeks
Team evaluating Persefoni for carbon accounting workflows

actions.action: Emergency stakeholder mapping — Lars Eriksson identified as bridge
actions.outcome: Scheduled re-demo for new sustainability team; 3 new users to activate

actions.action: VP CS direct outreach to CSO
actions.outcome: CSO agreed to 60-day platform evaluation before competitor decision

accounts.name: NorthLight Energy Analytics
accounts.narrative: Energy sector SaaS. API migration broke Golden Path — velocity crashed from 75% to 22%. Ticket resolution ballooned to 60hrs. Escalation rate 16%. NPS at 19. Persona Breadth 3.3 — organization wants the tool but can't use it. V5 API fix in progress.

key_signals.content: V5 API migration broke Golden Path workflows — velocity collapsed from 75% to 22%
VP Digital escalated to our CRO — formal breach of uptime SLA noted
NPS crashed from 51 to 19 — grid analytics team majority now detractors

actions.action: Engineering SWAT team on API migration fix — daily status calls
actions.outcome: Golden Path Velocity recovering to 44% — teams cautiously re-engaging

actions.action: Weekly executive review with VP Digital
actions.outcome: Escalation rate falling from 16% to 9%; SLA breach remediation plan signed

accounts.name: Citadel Compliance Group
accounts.narrative: Compliance SaaS for financial institutions. Regulatory team restructured — exec sponsor and champion both departed. Golden Path Velocity at 10%, Persona Breadth 0.7 (single user). NPS 2, escalation rate 24%. GRR 63%. Renewal in 30 days — 138-day warning missed entirely.

key_signals.content: CCO Richard Holt resigned — was exec sponsor and regulatory workflow designer
Persona Breadth dropped from 4.8 to 0.7 — full compliance team offboarded with CCO
CFO flagged contract for immediate non-renewal review — no compliance owner
IT team evaluating Riskonnect as unified GRC replacement

actions.action: CEO-to-CFO call — presented regulatory risk of platform gap during transition
actions.outcome: CFO granted 90-day extension pending CCO replacement hire

actions.action: Compliance onboarding sprint — 4 new team members trained
actions.outcome: Persona Breadth recovering to 2.0; Golden Path Velocity at 28%

actions.action: Regulatory audit trail ROI report — $5.1M in avoided fines documented
actions.outcome: CFO reopened annual renewal conversation — final decision pending CCO hire
